blocks.label: Aho-Corasick failure build
blocks.py:
# Aho-Corasick failure links via BFS:
from collections import deque
def build_fail(root):
    q = deque()
    for u in root.ch.values():
        u.fail = root; q.append(u)
    while q:
        v = q.popleft()
        for c, u in v.ch.items():
            f = v.fail
            while f and c not in f.ch: f = f.fail
            u.fail = f.ch[c] if f and f.ch[c] is not u else root
            u.out += u.fail.out          # merge pattern outputs
            q.append(u)
